hypothesis: The remaining unexplained work may scale with lexical units rather than a polynomial of character length. Combining word count and character count should better represent tokenizer and token-list processing costs.

pcvs.name: default_options
pcvs.rationale: Separates the entry state containing the exceptional initialization cost.

pcvs.expression: len(prompt if isinstance(prompt, str) else prompt['prompt'])
pcvs.name: prompt_chars
pcvs.rationale: Captures character scanning and text conversion work.

pcvs.name: prompt_word_count
pcvs.rationale: Provides a cheap lexical-unit count to distinguish token-dependent work from character-dependent work.

pcvs.expression: int((tokenization_kwargs or {}).get('add_special_tokens', True) and 'truncate_prompt_tokens' not in (tokenization_kwargs or {}))
pcvs.name: special_tokens_without_truncation
pcvs.rationale: Captures the higher observed cost of special-token processing without explicit truncation.
